Builds maps of Japanese administrative areas and government offices from the National Land Numerical Information. Archived from CRAN in 2020; the source remains on [GitHub](https://github.com/uribo/jpndistrict); documentation at [uribo.github.io/jpndistrict](https://uribo.github.io/jpndistrict/).
